# GitHub Copilot can now interact with desktop apps with computer use

## What Changed

Computer use is now available in public preview in GitHub Copilot CLI and the GitHub Copilot app on macOS and Windows. Copilot can interact with desktop applications on your behalf…

## Why It Matters to a CSA

A preview can inform roadmap and technical validation, but is not a production commitment.

## Customer Impact

**Medium**. Lifecycle: `public-preview`. Change type: `new`.

## Recommended Action

Review preview terms, regions, limitations, and support before proposing a customer pilot.
